phase: Accounting Spine / F4 Eurostat-BSI exact-bridge diagnostic
purpose: Test whether retained Eurostat quarterly-financial-accounts MFI counterpart totals can be combined with retained ECB BSI MFIs-excluding-the-NCB loan series to isolate an exact BNR counterpart contribution. This is a diagnostic only and cannot materialize F4 cells.

eurostat.boundary: MIO_EUR; F4; reporting sector S121_S122_S123; counterpart S11 or S14_S15; ASS; STK at 2025-Q4 or TRN summed over 2025-Q1..Q4

ecb_bsi.boundary: Millions of euro; MFIs excluding the NCB; loans; domestic NFC or households/NPISH; December 2025 stock or ECB financial transactions summed over 2025

tested_bridge.hypothesis: Eurostat financial-accounts MFI F4 counterpart amount minus ECB BSI MFIs-excluding-NCB loan amount equals the BNR F4 counterpart amount.

methodological_adjudication.finding: ECB documentation explicitly identifies conceptual differences between MFI loans in financial accounts and BSI, including accrued-interest treatment, write-down/reclassification effects and government-sector rerouting. Eurostat financial accounts follow ESA 2010 and are a distinct financial-accounts statistical framework. Therefore cross-domain subtraction is not an exact accounting identity.
